case: DuckDB enum grid edit of literal NULL label
contract: The grid parser maps unquoted input NULL to text when NULL is a declared DuckDB ENUM label.
A keyed edit stores the literal NULL label as a non-NULL value and preserves the native ENUM type.
An untouched sibling row remains SQL NULL, distinguished by both its decoded value and the native null predicate.

focused_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --lib --features duckdb value_contract_duckdb_enum_literal_null_edit_stays_distinct_from_sql_null -- --test-threads=1

app_library_suite.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --lib --features duckdb -- --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --all-targets --features duckdb -- -D warnings

remaining: Installed GTK editing and broader DuckDB type, consumer and configuration parity remain open; this case does not close B3 or qualify the 0.2.0 release.
